title: Count syncs & active threads per step (1024-thread reduce, CUDA)
info: Real CUDA-C compiled by arena.cuda_c.CudaProgram, executed on arena.cuda_sim.GPU.
Single block of 1024 threads reducing 1024 elements to out[0].

smem_insts == 4*n-2 == 4094 is the closed-form total shared-memory instruction count for a correct log2(1024)=10-step tree reduction: n initial stores + 3*(n-1) load/load/store ops across the halving-active-thread steps + 1 final read; see check.py.
